节能目标与改造情况.值: In 2025, ZBOM continued to advance the "oil-to-electric" transformation initiative, replacing high-energy-consumption fuel forklifts in batches, and introducing high-efficiency lithium-ion battery forklifts... 节能目标与改造情况.原文: In 2025, ZBOM continued to advance the "oil-to-electric" transformation initiative, replacing high-energy-consumption fuel forklifts in batches, and introducing high-efficiency lithium-ion battery forklifts, complemented by smart charging facilities to optimize energy management.
